description: Logical dataset groups derived for the seven audited pilots. NASA PSI does not expose a dataset entity or dataset-level descriptions through its API; each group is therefore derived deterministically from the top-level filename category and the PSI subcategory (experiment/run label). These IDs are FlameLens-internal and must not be presented as PSI-issued dataset identifiers.

method.top_level_category_rule: Text between the '<PSI-ID>_' prefix and the next underscore in the filename, e.g. 'Raw Data', 'Science Documents', 'Engineering Documents'.
method.subcategory_field: PSI file object 'subcategory' (experiment/run label), empty when PSI omits it.
method.subcategory_normalization: trim, then collapse whitespace around '/' to a single '/'
known_filename_anomalies: PSI-101 contains a top-level label 'SAME' that is not a PSI category
